description: Curated list of BOE consolidated documents. `boe_seed` downloads everything; `boe_watch` re-checks via the /metadatos API any entry with `track: true` (default) and re-downloads when fecha_actualizacion changes. Set `track: false` for documents that are NOT consolidated by BOE (sentencias TC, órdenes puntuales sin enmiendas) — they get downloaded once and left alone.
